statistical_protocol.input: Integer final costs paired by trial seed.
statistical_protocol.test: Two-sided exact Wilcoxon signed-rank test, excluding zero differences and accounting for tied ranks.
statistical_protocol.n_eff: Number of nonzero paired differences; p=1 when n_eff=0.
statistical_protocol.baseline_Holm_families: 32 tests for n=100/150 and a separate 32 tests for n=200/300.
statistical_protocol.policy_Holm_family: 320 pairwise tests among five policies across 32 held-out instances.
